fonts.display: 'Stk bureau Sans Book Trial', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Stk bureau Serif Book Trial', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

palette.name: Parchment Cream
palette.role: Alternate surface and product-mockup backdrop — the warm cream gives the white canvas a second, softer layer without introducing contrast noise

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary headings, body text, and the heaviest borders — a near-black with the faintest plum undertone, softer than pure #000 for large blocks of text

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary text, icon strokes, and lighter borders — the mid-neutral that separates captions from body without going to gray

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas and card surfaces — the dominant background across the entire system

palette.name: Fog Border
palette.role: Hairline dividers, badge fills, and the softest UI separators

palette.name: Silver
palette.role: Mid-weight dividers and de-emphasized body borders

palette.name: Sky Highlight
palette.role: In-line accent on chosen words within headings, and soft card iconography — a dusty pastel blue that reads as annotation, never as brand chrome

palette.name: Sage Action
palette.role: Primary CTA fill and decorative wash — the only saturated fill in the interface, used sparingly so the button always feels intentional
